trailhead.label: The Falzeben car park above Hafling, the board’s start

cautions: The board warns of occasional construction traffic on path 14: lead on and step aside for vehicles.
Most of the loop is on wide forest roads in a ski area, shared with farm and service vehicles.
Cattle graze around the Maiser and Moschwald alms in summer: keep your dog on a short lead and give cows a wide berth.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
